compiled_state.title: Rewrite applier.py with _LEAVES dict registry + DirectionMismatchError per leaf + UnknownActionError
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Each (direction, action) leaf raises DirectionMismatchError when called with mismatched direction
- dd-2: apply() with unknown action raises UnknownActionError with zero side-effects

Rewrite plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py:
- _LEAVES: dict[tuple[Direction, Action], Callable[[Mutation], None]] keyed by (direction, action)
- apply(mutation) does dict lookup; KeyError -> UnknownActionError (no client calls, no log writes)
- Each leaf: one-line guard `if mutation.direction is not Direction.X: raise DirectionMismatchError(...)`
- Skeleton only — bodies of _outbound_create rollback (task-4), _inbound_clean_label (task-5), _outbound_update (task-7) come later
- Legacy modules stay imported (deleted in task-6 after applier no longer needs them)

UPDATE existing tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier*.py: one direction-mismatch test per leaf; UnknownActionError test with mock client asserted not_called.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given Mutation(direction=OUTBOUND) and an INBOUND leaf called directly; When invoked; Then DirectionMismatchError raised. AND apply() with unknown (direction, action) + MagicMock client; When called; Then UnknownActionError raised, no mock method called.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py
- [ ] _LEAVES is dict keyed by (Direction, Action)
  Verify: python3 -c "from plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.applier import _LEAVES; assert isinstance(_LEAVES, dict)"
- [ ] DirectionMismatchError per leaf
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier.py -k direction_mismatch
- [ ] UnknownActionError zero side-effects
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier.py::test_unknown_action_no_side_effects

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier.py — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): (a) Skeleton leaf bodies MUST each raise NotImplementedError explicitly — guarantees RED state for downstream task-4/5/7 tests. (b) DO NOT MERGE task-3 INDEPENDENTLY — task-3 + task-4 + task-5 + task-7 must land atomically (same commit / story branch merge) since task-3 alone produces non-deployable applier.py. (c) Define Direction and Action enums in task-1 _errors.py (rename module purpose to _domain.py or co-locate types) — task-3 needs these for _LEAVES dict keys. (d) Define RETRY_BUDGET constant in task-1 OR task-3 at the same scope; value 3 (matches current _call_with_retry max_retries default). (e) Clarify apply() input contract: accepts Mutation typed object from draft-1 (new), NOT old dict format; task-3 updates all existing test_applier.py call sites to use Mutation; backward-compat shim out of scope (existing dict-based tests rewritten in task-3's UPDATE work). (f) Each leaf gets BOTH negative direction test (mismatch raises DirectionMismatchError) AND positive direction test (match calls downstream client method).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Promote positive direction tests to AC verify line. Per cycle-1 revision, each leaf gets BOTH negative AND positive direction tests. AC additions: (a) pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier.py -k positive_direction [one test per leaf confirming match direction triggers downstream client method invocation]; (b) corresponding negative-path tests already in AC (-k direction_mismatch).

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): apply() dispatch order must be (1) validate action in _LEAVES keys → else UnknownActionError, (2) validate direction match → else DirectionMismatchError, (3) invoke leaf body. Add test that asserts every _LEAVES entry is either fully implemented OR explicitly marked @pending in a registry; CI fails if any leaf still raises NotImplementedError at story-branch merge time (catches incomplete atomic merge). Rationale: prevents NotImplementedError leaking past the UnknownActionError contract during partial atomic merge (implicit_assumption).
